news.headline: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
news.summary: Accel snapped up $550M for its new India fund in record time, despite still deploying capital from a prior $650M vehicle. The oversubscribed close signals sustained investor appetite for India-focused tech bets, even as the firm manages a substantial dry powder position from its previous fund.

news.headline: Why Jensen Huang’s $500 billion AI financing plan faces a big risk from China
news.summary: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is proposing GPUs as collateral to unlock $500B in funding—but the strategy hinges on a critical unknown: how quickly will the chips lose value as technology advances? The depreciation risk could make lenders wary of backing the ambitious plan.

educational.title: Bull Market vs. Bear Market — What the Terms Actually Mean
points: A bull market is a sustained rise in prices; a bear market is a sustained fall
The common threshold: a 20%+ drop from a recent high defines a bear market
Bull markets historically last far longer than bear markets on average
Investor psychology often overshoots in both directions — greed, then fear
Long-term investors are taught to expect both phases, not just the good one
